description: Whether a school's academic policy index is held and current. The index points a build at the few pages that hold the school's academic policies, the award's first. Give unitid. The answer gives status (none, running, done or failed), current (true only for a done run built from the publish this server serves now), publish_version and served_publish_version, rows, award_policy (stated, where the index found a page for the award's requirements; standard, where it found none, so the standard policy is used and named as its source), run_id, started_at, finished_at and any error. Read-only.

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
